one_at_a_time.rule: Run only one remedy at a time: 40 or 43 consecutive days (p.133 says 'days / weeks'; p.74-75 explains 40 = 28 nakshatras + 12 signs, 43 at most), pause a few days, then start the next. Two remedies at once nullify the fruit.
